s: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when «deep» «sleep» falleth on men,

H8609.d: to sew together; (Qal) to sew, sew together
s: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they «sewed» fig leaves «together», and made themselves aprons.

H8669.d: desire, longing, craving; of man for woman; of woman for man; of beast to devour
s: I am my beloved’s, and his «desire» is toward me.

H8610.d: to catch, handle, lay hold, take hold of, seize, wield; (Niphal) to be seized, be arrested, be caught, be taken, captured; (Piel) to catch, grasp (with the hands)
s: And the king of Ai they «took» alive, and brought him to Joshua.
The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be «taken» in the devices that they have imagined.
And his brother’s name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as «handle» the harp and organ.

H8672.d: nine, nonad; nine (as cardinal number); ninth (as ordinal number); in combination with other numbers
s: And all the days that Adam lived were «nine» hundred and thirty years: and he died.
And in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth «day» of the month, the city was broken up.
And Enos lived «ninety» years, and begat Cainan:

H8659.d: § Tarshish or Tharshish = "yellow jasper"; a city of the Phoenicians in a distant part of the Mediterranean Sea to which the prophet Jonah was trying to flee; a city somewhere near and accessible to the Red Sea to which ships constructed at Ezion-geber on the Elanitic Gulf on the Red Sea were to sail
s: Thou breakest the ships of «Tarshish» with an east wind.
And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and «Tarshish», Kittim, and Dodanim.

H8646.d: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.11.24;; the father of Abraham; a station of Israel in the wilderness
s: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat «Terah»:
And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at «Tarah».

H8655.d: § 1) idolatry, idols, image(s), teraphim, family idol; a kind of idol used in household shrine or worship
s: And the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and «teraphim», and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.
And when the messengers were come in, behold, there was an «image» in the bed, with a pillow of goats’ hair for his bolster.

H8628.d: to blow, clap, strike, sound, thrust, give a blow, blast
s: When ye «blow» an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
But the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, and he «blew» a trumpet; and Abi-ezer was gathered after him.
And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and «thrust» it into his belly:

H8641.d: contribution, offering; a heave offering; any offering; an offering to God; an offering (of grain, money, etc); contribution
s: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an «heave» offering unto the LORD.
And this is the «offering» which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
And the right «shoulder» shall ye give unto the priest for an «heave» offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

H8665.d: woven work, checkered material, chequered or plaited work
s: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a «girdle»: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

H8658.d: a precious stone or semi-precious gem; perhaps a chrysolite, yellow jasper, or other yellow coloured stone
s: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the «colour» of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.

H8622.d: coming round, circuit of time or space, a turning, circuit; at the circuit (as adverb)
s: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his «circuit» unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

H8601.d: broken piece, baked pieces, pieces cooked; meaning uncertain
s: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, thou shalt bring it in: and the baken «pieces» of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the LORD.

H8643.d: alarm, signal, sound of tempest, shout, shout or blast of war or alarm or joy; alarm of war, war-cry, battle-cry; blast (for march); shout of joy (with religious impulse); shout of joy (in general)

When ye blow an «alarm», then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with «joy»: for he will render unto man his righteousness.
On the «ninth» day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin, offered:
Take thou no usury of him, or «increase»: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.

H8617.d: standing, ability or power to stand
s: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no «power» to «stand» before your enemies.
The king of «Tirzah», one: all the kings thirty and one.

These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and «Tophel», and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

H8615.d: hope, expectation; hope; ground of hope; things hoped for, outcome
s: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy «hope», and the uprightness of thy ways?

Behold, when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this «line» of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father’s household, home unto thee.
Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their «deceit» is falsehood.
And he sent messengers unto Abimelech «privily», saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.

H8668.d: salvation, deliverance; deliverance (usually by God through human agency); salvation (spiritual in sense)
s: Make haste to help me, O Lord my «salvation».
Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is «safety».

H8666.d: a recurrence, an answer, return; return; at the return (construct); answer, reply
s: And his «return» was to Ramah; for there was his house; and there he judged Israel; and there he built an altar unto the LORD.
How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your «answers» there remaineth falsehood?

H8605.d: prayer; pray a prayer; house of prayer; hear prayer; in Ps titles (of poetic or liturgical prayer)
s: Then hear thou in heaven their «prayer» and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
And Ashur the father of «Tekoa» had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the «Tekoite»,
For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from «Tiphsah» even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.

Then Menahem smote «Tiphsah», and all that were therein, and the coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not to him, therefore he smote it; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up.
And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the «Tishbite», saying,
And the Avites made Nibhaz and «Tartak», and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

H8661.d: Tartan-field marshal, general, or commander; a title used by the Assyrian military
s: In the year that «Tartan» came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;

H8640.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.19.9
s: And when he heard say of «Tirhakah» king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against thee: he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah, saying,

H8616.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.22.14;; father of Shallum, the husband of the prophetess Huldah in the time of king Josiah of Judah; father of Jahaziah (Tikvah) in the time of Ezra
s: And Hilkiah, and they that the king had appointed, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of «Tikvath», the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that effect.
Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of «Tikvah» were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
Thus will I do unto this place, saith the LORD, and to the inhabitants thereof, and even make this city as «Tophet»:

H8647.d: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.2.48
s: Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Sheber, and «Tirhanah».
And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the «Tirathites», the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.

H8660.d: Tirshatha-governor; a title used by the Persian governor in Judea

s: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly «strong», and partly broken.
How great are his signs! and how «mighty» are his wonders! his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and his dominion is from generation to generation.

H8648.d: two; two (as cardinal number); second (as ordinal number); two (in combination with other numbers)
s: At the end of «twelve» months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.

H8674.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.5.3
s: Now therefore, «Tatnai», governor beyond the river, Shethar-boznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be ye far from thence:

H8657.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Est.2.21
s: And it was found written, that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and «Teresh», two of the king’s chamberlains, the keepers of the door, who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.
Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all «authority», to confirm this second letter of Purim.

H8604.d: that which is empty, folly, silly, foolish; (BDB) unsavouriness, unseemliness (moral)
s: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not «folly» to them.
Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others «daubed» it with untempered morter:

H8630.d: (Qal) to prevail over or against, overcome, overpower

s: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with «shoutings», crying, Grace, grace unto it.
Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of «astonishment».

H8608.d: to play or sound the timbrel, beat, play upon, drum (on a timbrel or other object); (Qal) playing (participle); (Poel) beating (participle)
s: The singers went before, the «players» on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels «playing» with timbrels.

H8626.d: to equalise, make straight, become straight; (Qal) to become straight; (Piel) to make straight, put straight, arrange in order, set in order; (Hophal) to be established, be reestablished, confirm
s: Consider the work of God: for who can make that «straight», which he hath made crooked?
That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man: neither may he contend with him that is «mightier» than he.
Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their «mast», they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.

H8645.d: a type of tree; perhaps the cypress, holm-tree; meaning very uncertain
s: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the «cypress» and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.

Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your «dispersions» are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.
They have blown the «trumpet», even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.

H8642.d: portion, contribution, what belongs to a contribution or attendant or secondary contribution or subdivision
s: And this «oblation» of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.

Then Daniel requested of the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon: but Daniel sat in the «gate» of the king.

H8631.d: to grow strong, be hardened; (P'al); (Pael) to make strong, make firm, make stringent
s: The tree grew, and was «strong», and the height thereof reached unto heaven, and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth:

H8627.d: to be in order; (Hophal) to be established, be reestablished, confirm
s: At the same time my reason returned unto me; and for the glory of my kingdom, mine honour and brightness returned unto me; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me; and I was «established» in my kingdom, and excellent majesty was added unto me.

H8625.d: tekel, shekel; (P'al) tekel-a unit of weight, shekel
s: «TEKEL»; Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.
TEKEL; Thou art «weighed» in the balances, and art found wanting.

H8637.d: to go on foot, spy out, cause to walk; (Tiphel) to teach to walk
s: I «taught» Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
